assay: total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), vastus lateralis biopsies, HiSeq 2500 SE100
sample_inclusion: 13 sedentary middle-aged men: Ex-HFD n=7, Sed-HFD n=6 (TAB1); biopsy Pre and Post 9-day HFD (S2.1.p1)
repeated_measure_unit: subject (Pre and Post biopsy per subject)
primary_estimand: Within-group Post vs Pre change in muscle gene expression in Ex-HFD (HFD + 3 resistance-exercise bouts), compared with the Post vs Pre change in Sed-HFD (HFD alone); exercise effect inferred from the two lists (S3.1.p1-p2)
planned_contrasts: Ex-HFD Post vs Pre, paired by subject (S2.6.p1, S3.1.p1; paper: 2617 DEGs, 1561 up / 1056 down)
Sed-HFD Post vs Pre, paired by subject (S2.6.p1, S3.1.p1; paper: 412 DEGs, 264 up / 148 down)
normalization: featureCounts gene coverage; filter rpkm > 0.1 in >= 5 samples (23,373 genes kept) (S2.6.p1, S2.3.p1)
paper_method: edgeR glmQLFit/glmQLFTest, y ~ Timepoint + Subject fitted separately in each group (S2.6.p1)
paper_results: Sed-HFD 412 DEGs; Ex-HFD 2617 DEGs; overlap 240 up / 103 down; CHAC1 up in Ex, down in Sed; ANGPTL4 changed only in Ex (Fig5I); Table 2 Sed-only genes SLPI, IRAK2, NUPR1 up, FGF6, MDH1 down
